events.verdict: George (WAS) brings his right hand down towards the ball and marginal contact occurs with Robinson (TOR) after the release of his layup attempt.
Sarr (WAS) legally contests Robinson's (TOR) layup attempt in the paint.
Sarr (WAS) firms up in Shead's (TOR) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the pick.
Shead (TOR) legally contests Poole's (WAS) jump shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Poole (WAS) makes last contact with the ball prior to it falling out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Toronto.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Shead (TOR) makes last contact with the ball prior to it bouncing out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Washington.
Middleton (WAS) firms up over his left leg as Lawson (TOR) moves towards the pick and marginal contact occurs as Lawson defends over the pick.
Robinson (TOR) legally contests Sarr's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
Coulibaly (WAS) legally contests Lawson's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
George (WAS) is drawn into the air toward Rhoden (TOR) and he comes down into Rhoden's space, delivering contact to his arm that affects his shot attempt in the paint.
Rhoden (TOR) and Middleton (WAS) momentarily come together as the screen is set and the contact is marginal.
Rhoden (TOR) legally contests Middleton's (WAS) shot attempt in the post.
Poole (WAS) and Rhoden (TOR) engage and disengage off ball the contact is marginal.
Sarr (WAS) legally contests Shead's (TOR) driving shot attempt.
Sarr (WAS) sets the pick and makes marginal contact with Rhoden (TOR) as he rolls to the basket.
Robinson (TOR) legally contests Middleton's (WAS) jump shot attempt.

Replay is triggered when a shot clock violation is called on the floor. Upon further review, Middleton's (WAS) shot attempt comes into contact with the rim and the shot clock violation is amended to an inadvertent whistle. Toronto is in possession of the ball at the time of the whistle and is awarded possession. Toronto would elect to use a timeout in order to advance the ball into the frontcourt.

Shead (TOR) requests and is granted a timeout during the throw-in. There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that confirms that he steps on to the court over the boundary line before the timeout is granted.

Smart (WAS) moves alongside Shead's (TOR) path and does not deliver any illegal contact prior to the game clock expiring during Shead's driving shot attempt. Replay review shows that Shead does not fully release the ball prior to the game clock expiring and the basket is disallowed.
